offering_description.value: Mines and processes sorbent clay minerals into cat litter, agricultural carriers, industrial absorbents and animal health products. Sells to consumers via retailers, and to industrial, agricultural and food-industry customers.

primary_products.value: cat litter; industrial floor absorbents; agricultural chemical carriers; animal health and feed additives; bleaching clay and fluids purification products

customer_segment.value: B2C: pet owners buying cat litter and consumer products; B2B: retailers, industrial distributors, agrochemical makers, edible oil processors, animal feed producers, sports field operators

end_markets.value: pet care; industrial maintenance and spill cleanup; agriculture; edible oil refining; sports turf

revenue_model.value: product sales: packaged and bulk sorbent mineral products sold to retailers and industrial customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: mines clay and processes it into finished sorbent products sold to retailers, distributors and industry; raw materials: supplies bulk clay-based carriers and bleaching clays to processors

geography_served.value: global: US, Canada, Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: consumer cat litter and business-to-business sorbent products from shared clay mining and processing

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: mass merchants, grocery, club and pet stores for cat litter; distributors / dealers: industrial and agricultural distributors; direct sales: bulk sales to private-label customers and processors; online: e-commerce retailers
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; distributors / dealers; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: mining safety (MSHA), environmental rules, and FDA/EPA requirements for animal health and agricultural products
